highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Are you planning to join Cesar Ritz colleges in Switzerland? Well, you've made a great choice. In the hospitality and business education sector, the college is one of the top ranked. As per QS Rankings 2024, Ceser Ritz colleges are in the 3rd position globally for hospitality and leisure management. The institute combines practical skills and academic knowledge in the courses it offers, and it focuses on preparing you for leadership positions in the global hospitality industry. Besides, the college environment is warm and multicultural as you'll see students from around 60 countries.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: As a student, you'll have a vibrant and multicultural environment at Cesar Ritz Colleges. Students from around 60 countries study here. With well-equipped kitchens, vast libraries, and recreational areas, you'll find all the modern facilities at the college. Also, the social activities, cultural events, and networking opportunities are sure to enhance your learning experience as a student. The career support offered is aimed at connecting you with industry leaders to make sure you'll land a job you'll love.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At Cesar Ritz Colleges, you'll stay on campus in fully furnished rooms with modern amenities. You'll have many options to choose from, like single and shared rooms within budgets you're comfortable with. The accommodation here is designed to help you focus on your studies while enjoying a beautiful community life. The rooms obviously have amenities like a bed, desk, shelves, and ensuite washroom. With healthy meal options for dining, easy access to classrooms, and an amazing social life, we're sure that accommodation at Cesar Ritz Colleges will be a wonderful experience for you.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library

The wide collection of books, journals, and digital assets at the César Ritz Library will amaze you. The quiet libraries will definitely help you gain quite a lot of insights about hospitality and business studies.

Sports

The college offers well-organised sports activities to nurture team spirit and fitness. Along with your studies, you'll have a balanced life with a range of sports to take part in.

Laboratory

The hospitality labs at Cesar Ritz Colleges include modern facilities with professional kitchens and mock hotel setups. You'll get hands-on training in culinary arts here, and it will help you understand the real-world applications of the theory you learn.

Cafeteria

The cafeteria at Cesar Ritz Colleges is a vibrant space to unwind and make social connections. You'll find various meal options that cater to distinct tastes and dietary preferences.
